body: For the BUG-2398 implementer ONLY: read newest advisor comment before edits/push. Independent final design approval is conditional on B1 finalizing at spawn AFTER own child grant+identity/customize (not early argv builders); explicit child env only. B2 exact whitelist MUST include AIDA_ROLE_INSTANCE, test companion does not become driver. B3 explicitly exclude HANDLE_LAUNCH_TOKEN and AGENT_REGISTRY_TOKEN; document tool shells cannot bind handles. B4 real sandbox test proves present-empty baseline. Full contract on spec; no other lane should change its scope. Do not relax global policy/keyring/validators.
subject: BUG-2398 binding final sketch amendments B1-B4
